author: agent:claude-code
message: The root rename (dotfiles → vg-dotfiles) left every decision pinned to node paths that no longer exist. Restate each unchanged, resting on the renamed nodes, superseding the old entry. (proposal 01a14718-841d-72ba-950d-aadd9d95c5aa, proposed by agent:claude-code, accepted by user)

title: Hyprland config is raw live-edited files, not home-manager's hyprland module
body: home-manager's wayland.windowManager.hyprland generates ~/.config/hypr/hyprland.conf, which would collide with hypr.d linked out of store. The compositor comes from the NixOS module (programs.hyprland, withUWSM); everything else is raw config in hypr.d, waybar.d, fuzzel.d, mako.d, qt6ct.d and uwsm.d, started from autostart.conf rather than systemd user units so none of it leaks into the Plasma session. Validated with Hyprland 0.52.2 --verify-config and fuzzel --check-config; not yet run on hardware.

title: Plasma stays as a fallback session beside Hyprland until Hyprland has run on the 7800 XT
body: core.desktop.sessions became a list so SDDM offers both. A broken Hyprland config or session environment then never locks the user out. Plasma adds 59 KDE packages (visible in fuzzel) but none of its theming, wallet or portals reach the Hyprland session. Drop it with core.desktop.sessions = [ "hyprland" ] once Hyprland is proven on the machine.

title: gnome-keyring as the Secret Service, Chromium apps forced onto it
body: Proton Pass is the password manager, but Electron and Chromium apps (Proton Pass itself, VS Code, Vivaldi) keep their own tokens in the system keyring, and they don't recognise Hyprland as a desktop, so they fall back to obfuscated plaintext. gnome-keyring runs standalone (unlocked by SDDM's PAM) and the three apps get --password-store=gnome-libsecret on vgkraken (verified in the built wrappers). Its gcr-ssh-agent is turned off: gpg-agent is already the SSH agent (core/env.nix), and two agents would race for SSH_AUTH_SOCK.

title: Headless is two switches, core.headless (system) and nixtype.headless (home)
body: The repo also builds standalone homeConfigurations for option inspection, and those load only home/. Setting home options from the NixOS module (home-manager.users.<user>) would make that inspection show GUI apps that aren't installed. Same split as vgmacbook's tailscale (cask in nix/, alias in home/). Open alternative: a `headless` fact in the flake's configurations table passed through specialArgs, so both trees default from one value.

title: AMD GPUs get LACT with overdrive and ROCm OpenCL as opt-in switches
body: core.graphics.amd: early KMS and 32-bit graphics always; lact.enable adds lactd plus hardware.amdgpu.overdrive (RDNA3 fan control needs the ppfeaturemask), opencl.enable adds ROCm, clinfo and the render/video groups. All three 7800 XT hosts turn both on. ROCm, the kernel and LACT come from the binary cache (dry-run build), so nothing large compiles. NVIDIA options stay, now off by default.

title: Host checks are an eval-only script, not `nix flake check` (yet)
body: `nix flake check` evaluates every nixosConfigurations entry, so it cannot pass until vgnixmini, vgsquid-azul and vgsquid-onyx have hardware-configuration.nix (generated on each machine). nix/scripts/check-hosts.sh evaluates each system and home configuration's drvPath, reports those hosts as PENDING, and fails only on real errors, so it is usable as a regression check today. Moving to flake `checks` + CI (baseline rule nix.flake-check) waits on the three hardware configs.
